title: A cup of water
blurb: An old woman on a farm can't reach her well. Walk, look, talk, and take her a drink.
after: Wenna will remember you, and so will anyone she tells. That's how it works everywhere here: people see what you do, and pass it on.
refines: Do first-time players find clicking, dragging from the pack and giving without help? Does a first conversation feel answered?
goal: Help the old woman on the bench

npc_wenna_ash.goal: rest her bad leg on the bench

npc_pip_ash.goal: chase the hens round the yard

npc_ada_miller.goal: buy eggs at Wenna's hen coop

things.name: wooden cup
things.description: A turned wooden drinking cup, worn smooth with use.

things.name: well
things.description: A round stone well with a little roof and a windlass. Its bucket has just been wound up and sits on the rim, full of cold, clean water.

things.name: well bucket
things.description: The well's wooden bucket, iron-hooped, on its rope at the rim: wound up and brimming with cold water.

things.name: windfall apple
things.description: A small green apple fallen from the tree, bruised on one side.

steps.title: A farmyard
cards: …signal. There you are. It's me, the device you came through with. Only you can hear me.
This is a small farm, a morning's walk from the city. It's a good place to learn how things work here, one thing at a time.
While I'm talking, the world waits for you. Press {Enter} or click Next.

steps.title: Walking
cards: Walk with {W} {A} {S} {D} or the arrow keys. Hold {Shift} to run.
See the old woman on the bench by the cottage? Walk over to her.
steps.task: Walk over to the old woman on the bench
steps.done: Good. You can go anywhere you like here.
help: She's on the bench in front of the cottage, at the top left. The arrow at the edge of the screen points to her.

steps.title: Talking
cards: To talk, {Left-click} someone, or stand near them and press {T}. A box opens at the bottom.
Type in your own words and press {Enter}. There are no lines to choose from: people answer as themselves. Try these words, or your own:

suggest.text: Good morning. Are you all right?

steps.task: Talk to the old woman: click her, type, press Enter

on_done.text: Water, that's what's wrong. My leg won't take me to the well today and the boy's off after the hens. My cup's by the well. Fill it for me, would you?

on_done.lead: Bring Wenna a cup of water from the well
on_done.said: My cup's by the well. Fill it for me, would you?

steps.done: Her name's Wenna. What she asked of you is in your journal now, and on the tracker at the top left.
help: {Left-click} her to open the box at the bottom, type something, and press {Enter}.
Or press Type it for me on the card, then {Enter}.

playtest.say: Good morning. Are you all right?

steps.title: Looking closer
cards: Everything here is real: it has weight, it's made of something, and it may belong to someone.
Hover over anything to see its name. {Right-click} to look closer. Find the cup by the well and right-click it.
steps.task: Right-click the cup by the well to look closer
steps.done: That card says what a thing is, what it's made of and whose it is. Click anywhere to close it.
help: The cup is just beside the well, in the middle of the yard. Point at it and press the right mouse button.

steps.title: Picking up
cards: {Left-click} something to pick it up: you walk there first. Or stand next to it and press {E}. Pick up the cup.
steps.task: Pick up the cup: left-click it
steps.done: It's in your pack now, along the bottom of the screen.
help: Point at the cup and press the left mouse button. Or walk right up to it and press {E}.

steps.title: Your pack
cards: Press {I} to open Pack & gear: what's in your hands, what you carry, any wounds. Have a look, then close it with {Esc}.
steps.task: Press I to open Pack & gear
steps.done: You can carry about twenty kilos. The weight is on the right of your pack.
help: Press the {I} key on your keyboard.

steps.title: Doing things
cards: You can do anything you can describe. Press {T}, then {Tab} until DO is lit: your words turn red. Describe what you do and press {Enter}. The world decides if it works.
The well's bucket is up on the rim, full. Fill the cup from it: drag the cup onto the bucket, or type it. Try this:

suggest.text: fill the cup from the well bucket

steps.task: Fill the cup at the well
steps.done: Cold, clean water. Nobody told the world a cup can be filled: it worked because a cup holds water.
help: Walk to the well, press {T}, press {Tab} until DO is lit, type 'fill the cup from the well bucket' and press {Enter}.
Or drag the cup from your pack onto the bucket, then press {Enter}.

playtest.do: fill the cup from the well bucket

try_also: fill the cup at the well
dip the cup in the bucket of water

steps.title: Giving
cards: Now take it to Wenna. Drag the cup from your pack onto her, check the line, and press {Enter}. Or say it in your own words.

suggest.text: give the cup of water to Wenna

steps.task: Give Wenna the cup of water

on_done.text: Ahh. Bless you, child. Ada from the mill's over by the coop for her eggs, and she's always short of a strong pair of hands. Pip! Run and tell her what this one did for me.

on_done.lead: Ada from the mill is by the hen coop, and she's short of hands.
on_done.said: Ada from the mill's over by the coop for her eggs, and she's always short of a strong pair of hands.

on_done.message: The stranger drew Gran's water at the well and brought it to her, when her leg wouldn't carry her.

steps.done: She'll remember that. And Pip's off to tell Ada: people here pass on what they see you do.
help: Walk up to Wenna. Drag the cup from your pack onto her and press {Enter}.
Or click her and type: give her the cup of water.

playtest.do: give the cup of water to Wenna

steps.title: Your journal
cards: What people tell you goes in your journal. Press {J} to open it: what's asked of you, what you've learned, and everyone you've met.
steps.task: Press J to open your journal
steps.done: Pin a lead in the journal and the tracker follows it, and marks the person it's about.
help: Press the {J} key on your keyboard, or click the tracker at the top left.

steps.title: Ask me
cards: Now me. Press {H} and ask me anything. I only know what you've seen and been told. Try asking me who Ada is.
steps.task: Press H and ask the device about Ada
steps.done: Ask me whenever you're stuck. I'll point the way, but I won't walk it for you.
help: Press {H}, type a question and press {Enter}. Or click one of the ready questions.

steps.title: Word gets around
cards: Pip's run off to tell Ada what you did. Nobody asked him to keep it quiet.
Go and talk to Ada by the hen coop, and see what she's heard.
steps.task: Talk to Ada by the hen coop
steps.done: That's the basics: walk, look, take, talk, do, give. And word travels: Ada heard about you from Pip.
help: She's by the hen coop, east of the well. Click her and say anything.

on_done.text: You'll be the one who drew Wenna's water, then. Pip came running to tell me. If it's work you're after, come down to the mill.

on_done.lead: Ada at the water mill has work for a pair of hands.
on_done.said: If it's work you're after, come down to the mill.

reactions.killed: …You killed someone. That can't be undone, and everyone who saw it will remember. Rewind from the menu if that isn't what you meant.
reactions.arrested: They've taken you away. Rewind from the menu to try again.
reactions.dead: You died. Rewind to the last calm moment and try something else.
